description: Create a text, voice, forum, stage, announcement, or category channel, optionally inside a category, and optionally private or read-only from the start. private_to, read_only and posting_roles compile to permission overwrites and are applied in the same call, so a private channel is one request rather than a create followed by set_channel_permissions. Use set_channel_permissions for anything finer. Voice and forum settings (bitrate, user limit, region, default reaction, sort, layout, required tags) can be set at creation too. Supports dry_run.

bitrate_kbps.description: Voice and stage audio quality in kbps. Up to 96 without boosts, 128, 256, and 384 at boost levels 1 to 3.

category.description: Category name or ID to place the channel under.

default_reaction.description: Forum: the emoji offered on every post, as a character or a custom emoji name; none to remove.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

post_slowmode_seconds.description: Forum: the slowmode each new post starts with.

posting_roles.description: Role names that may still post and start threads when read_only is set. Has no effect on its own.

private_to.description: Role names that can see the channel. Everyone else is denied View Channel, and Connect too on voice, stage and category. Do not list @everyone.

read_only.description: Deny sending to everyone, for rules and announcement channels.

region.description: Voice region id such as us-east or rotterdam, or automatic.

require_tag.description: Forum: posts must carry at least one tag.

thread_archive_minutes.description: How long new threads stay open without activity: 60, 1440 (a day), 4320, or 10080 (a week).

user_limit.description: Most people at once, 0 for no limit. Up to 99 in voice, 10000 in stage.

video_quality.description: Camera quality in voice channels: auto, or full (720p).

title: Create channel
